The InfluenceHER Collective™ · Campaign Film · Reels Edition

👑 Anthem Storyboard — “By Whom”

Fourteen frames, built natively vertical (9:16) for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. The cast now reflects the full, natural range of the village — from light caramel to deep mahogany — across individual and ensemble shots. Gold-bordered frames are the signature hybrid device: real cinematography meeting the app's own painted world, generated at 4K against the app's actual artwork.

CTA · Closing Card

12 · Get the App

“We InfluenceHER — coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.”

Composed from real assets at 2160×3840: actual wordmark, actual entry screen, App Store + Google Play badges with Coming Soon ribbons, weinfluenceher.org.

From stills to the Reel

  1. Approve / swap frames — anything re-rolls in minutes.
  2. Animate — 4–6s vertical motion per frame; paint particles drift, the sunburst grows, the reflection lags a half-beat behind the real girl.
  3. Voice + music — warm narrator over a building soul-inflected bed; italics above are the working script. Captions burned in.
  4. Cuts — 30s hero Reel, 15s teaser, and 6s app-card bumper; the 16:9 set is retained for YouTube/web.
